title: solanum dulcamara f. rupestre
intro: Solanum dulcamara f. rupestre, commonly known as climbing nightshade or bitter nightshade, is a subspecies of the Solanum dulcamara plant. This plant has been used for centuries in traditional medicine due to its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Solanum dulcamara f. rupestre include acting as an antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic agent, which can help alleviate symptoms of various conditions such as muscle spasms, wounds, and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include solanine, solanidine, and other glycoalkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
